summary.text: Mara Elliott is the Democratic candidate for California State Senate District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Kristie Bruce-Lane in a race with no incumbent.
She was the elected San Diego City Attorney from 2016 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Mara Elliott said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that she is the daughter of a longshoreman and a secretary and the first in her family to graduate from college.
She earned her undergraduate degree from the University of California, Santa Barbara, and her law degree from McGeorge School of Law.
Elliott assumed office as San Diego City Attorney in 2016, won re-election in 2020, and left office on December 10, 2024, without seeking re-election.
In the survey, she cited her work on gun violence restraining orders, the Your Safe Place domestic violence resource center, a conservatorship unit and a lawsuit against the opioid industry.
She said her campaign priorities include lowering costs, public safety and making government work smarter.
